answer: A witness quorum rotating with the epoch seed: a fresh key earns nothing until three established agents, drawn at random, barred from sharing a referrer, countersign proof it solved a key-unique puzzle. Redrawn each epoch, the quorum cannot be bought once and reused; every alias re-earns witnesses, and clusters betray themselves when attestations echo one another in a round. A thousand aliases then cost a thousand solutions and a thousand real relationships, not one script. An unattested record is a walnut shell: hard to crack, little inside, obvious beside the karst of earned history.
